title: A Tight Epidemic Threshold for Competing Stochastic Infection Processes with Mutually Exclusive Immunity
summary: Stochastic infection processes are continuous-time Markov chains on graphs that assign each vertex one of multiple states, such as susceptible, infected, or recovered. Depending on the model, vertices change their state based on random transition rates and the states of their neighbors, resulting in a variety of complex dynamics. The body of rigorous literature is rich for processes that consider a single infection.
